label: Stance: AI sociability
summary: Changes the AI sociability value of a vassal whose active vassal stance is the given one, going by its name.
details: `$VASSAL_STANCE$` stands for the key of a vassal stance defined in common/vassal_stances, for example `glory_hound_ai_sociability` for the stance `glory_hound`. The game makes one such modifier per stance. Vanilla's stance notes only list it by name; the exact scale is not documented.

label: Accolade glory gain
summary: Changes by a percentage how much glory accolades gain, going by the game's name "Accolade Glory Gain".
details: Works on a character. Whose accolades are affected is not documented.

label: Accolades
summary: A character modifier named "accolades"; the game documents nothing more.
details: It has no display name in the game's texts. Going by its name it relates to accolades, but what it adds is not stated.

label: Extra fort level
summary: Adds to a fort level, going by its name.
details: Works on a character, a province or a county. The game documents nothing about what the level applies to; this reading rests on the name only.

label: Adult health
summary: Changes the health of the character, going by its name while they are an adult.
details: The game's name for it is simply "adult health" (a game concept). Works on a character. Whether it is flat is not documented; the key has no `_add` or `_mult` ending.

label: Advantage
summary: Adds to the character's advantage in battle.
details: Advantage is shown in the game with the command-modifier icon. The variants `attacker_advantage`, `coastal_advantage` and `controlled_province_advantage` exist separately. Works on a character. Whether it is flat is not documented.

label: Advantage vs. coreligionists
summary: Adds battle advantage when the character fights enemies of their own faith, going by its name.
details: Works on a character. The game has no display text for it, so this reading rests on the name only.

label: AI amenity spending
summary: Changes how much an AI ruler spends on amenities, going by its name.
details: Vanilla uses it in culture traditions and ethos pillars with values such as 0.1 and 1. Works on a character. What is spent and its exact scale are not documented.

label: AI amenity target
summary: Changes the amenity level an AI ruler aims for, going by its name.
details: Vanilla uses it in culture traditions and ethos pillars with values such as 0.1 and 0.75. Works on a character. Its exact scale is not documented.

label: AI boldness
summary: Changes the AI boldness value of the character, going by its name.
details: Vanilla's vassal stance notes list it together with the other AI values (honor, greed, rationality, energy, boldness, zeal, vengefulness, compassion, sociability). Presumably it matters for AI-controlled characters. The scale is not documented.

label: AI compassion
summary: Changes the AI compassion value of the character, going by its name.
details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

label: AI energy
summary: Changes the AI energy value of the character, going by its name.
details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

label: AI rationality

details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

label: AI vengefulness
summary: Changes the AI vengefulness value of the character, going by its name.
details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

label: AI war chance
summary: Changes how likely the AI character is to start wars, going by its name.
details: Works on a character. Its exact scale is not documented.

label: AI war cooldown
summary: Changes how long an AI ruler waits between wars, going by its name.
details: Vanilla culture traditions and ethos pillars use values such as -0.25, 3 and 10. The unit (days, months or a factor) is not documented here. Works on a character.

label: AI zeal
summary: Changes the AI zeal value of the character, going by its name.
details: One of the AI values named in vanilla's vassal stance notes. The scale is not documented.

label: Army damage
summary: Changes by a percentage the damage the character's armies deal.
details: Works on a character. A positive value presumably makes their armies hit harder, a negative one weaker.

label: Army gold upkeep
summary: Changes by a percentage the gold maintenance of the character's armies.
details: Works on a character. A negative value lowers the cost, a positive one raises it.

label: Army pursuit
summary: Changes by a percentage the pursuit of the character's armies.
details: Pursuit is a game concept; the game documents nothing more about it here. Works on a character.

label: Army screen
summary: Changes by a percentage the screen of the character's armies.
details: Screen is a game concept; the game documents nothing more about it here. Works on a character.

label: Siege weapon effectiveness
summary: Changes by a percentage how effective the character's siege weapons are.
details: The game's name for it is "Army Siege Weapon Effectiveness". Works on a character.

label: Army toughness
summary: Changes by a percentage the toughness of the character's armies.
details: Toughness is a game concept; the game documents nothing more about it here. Works on a character.

label: Artifact decay reduction
summary: Changes by a percentage the artifact decay reduction, going by its name.
details: Its display text is the same as that of the flat `_add` variant of this modifier. Works on a character, a province or a county. Whose artifacts are affected is not documented.

label: Attacker advantage
summary: Adds battle advantage for the character as the attacker.
details: The game's name is "Attacker Advantage". Works on a character. Whether it is flat is not documented.

label: Attraction opinion
summary: Opinion bonus other characters have of this character because of attraction, going by its name.
details: The game's name is "Attraction Opinion". Works on a character; presumably a flat opinion amount that can be negative. Who counts as attracted is not documented.

label: Piety from blood brothers
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly piety the character gets from their blood brothers.
details: Blood brothers is a game concept. Works on a character.

label: Prestige from blood brothers
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly prestige the character gets from their blood brothers.
details: Blood brothers is a game concept. Works on a character.

label: Renown from blood brothers
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly dynasty prestige (renown) the character gets from their blood brothers.
details: Blood brothers is a game concept. Works on a character.

label: Building gold cost

details: Works on a character, a province or a county. Whether the change is a flat amount or a percentage is not documented.

label: Building herd cost

details: Works on a character, a province or a county. Whether the change is flat or a percentage is not documented.

details: Works on a character, a province or a county. Whether the change is flat or a percentage is not documented.

details: Works on a character, a province or a county. Whether the change is flat or a percentage is not documented.

details: The `_add` ending means a flat number. Works on a character, a province or a county. What the slots belong to is not documented.

label: Vassals can be attacked
summary: Whether the character's vassals can be attacked, going by the game's text "Can vassals be attacked".
details: Works on a character, probably as a yes/no switch. Vanilla's peasant faction tests a trigger of the same name on the faction target (`can_vassals_be_attacked = yes`), but how the modifier itself is written is not shown.

label: Extra capital fort level
summary: Adds to the fort level of the capital, going by its name.
details: Works on a character, a province or a county. The game documents nothing more; this reading rests on the name only.

label: Capital fort level

label: Capital county control per month

label: Capital development growth
summary: Adds to the monthly development growth of the character's capital county, going by its name.
details: Development is a measure of how developed a county is. The `_add` ending means a flat amount each month. Works on a character.

label: Capital fertility decline
summary: Adds to the monthly county fertility decline of the character's capital.

label: Capital fertility growth

details: Works on a character.

label: Travel safety %
summary: Changes by a percentage the safety of the character's travel.
details: The percentage counterpart of `character_travel_safety`. Works on a character.

label: Travel speed

summary: Changes by a percentage the speed of the character's travel.

details: Its game text is just "Child Opinion", the same as `child_opinion`. Presumably a flat opinion amount. Works on a character.

label: Child health

label: Contract scheme speed
summary: Adds to the length of a phase of the character's task-contract schemes, going by its name.
details: The game's text is "Task Contract Scheme Speed". The `_add` ending means a flat amount. Works on a character. Whether a positive value speeds schemes up or slows them down is not documented.

label: Controlled territory advantage
summary: Adds battle advantage for the defender on territory it controls.
details: The game's text is "Controlled Territory Defender Advantage". Whether it is flat is not documented. Works on a character.
